info.title: Hello Laravel — Order API
info.description: API for the workstation order system. Register or log in to get a Bearer token, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request. `POST /orders` accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried request from a flaky mobile connection never creates a duplicate order.

post.description: Creates a user and immediately returns an access/refresh token pair, so the app can log the user straight in.

device_name.description: Free-text label for the issued tokens

post.description: Verifies the email/password and issues a new access/refresh token pair. Previous sessions (other devices) stay valid.

Trades a still-valid refresh token for a brand new access/refresh pair (rotation: the refresh token just used stops working). Call this when the API starts returning 401 with an access token. Must be called with the refresh token itself as the Bearer token, not the access token.

401.description: Refresh token missing, invalid, or expired — the user must log in again

403.description: A valid token was sent, but it is an access token, not a refresh token

get.description: Returns the account that owns the access token used on this request.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

post.description: Revokes both the access token and its matching refresh token for this session. Other devices/sessions are unaffected.

get.description: Newest first, 15 per page. Both filters are optional and can be combined.

post.description: Books one of a workstation's time slots — this *is* the order, there are no line items. Send a unique "Idempotency-Key" header so retrying this call after a lost response (common on mobile networks) replays the first result instead of double-booking.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A client-generated UUID, one per logical attempt. Reusing it returns the original response unchanged.

workstation_slot_id.description: From GET /workstations/{id}/slots — must still be available

409.description: slot_held (another user is on it right now — temporary, try again soon), slot_booked (permanent), or the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed by another in-flight request (no code)

422.description: Validation failed or the workstation is inactive

put.description: The workstation/slot is fixed at booking time and can't be changed here — cancel and rebook instead. Only pending or in-progress orders can be edited.

422.description: Validation failed, or the order is already completed/cancelled

delete.description: Only pending or cancelled orders can be deleted. Deleting a pending order also frees its slot.

422.description: The order is in_progress or completed and cannot be deleted

patch.description: Allowed moves: pending → in_progress or cancelled; in_progress → completed or cancelled. completed and cancelled are final. Cancelling frees the slot for others to book.

422.description: That status change is not allowed from the current status

get.description: Returns all workstations, each with its order count, ordered by code.

delete.description: Deletes the workstation and its unbooked slots. Refused if any order — past or present — was ever made against it.

422.description: This workstation has order history and cannot be deleted

200.description: Paginated orders for this workstation, newest first

get.description: One day's worth of bookable time slots (defaults to today). Each slot has a status: available, held (another user is on the confirm screen — temporary), held_by_you, or booked. Poll this every few seconds while the slot picker is open to keep it current.

post.summary: Hold a slot while confirming a booking
post.description: Call this when the user taps a slot, before showing the confirm screen. It reserves the slot for a few minutes so nobody else starts booking it. Calling it again while you still hold the slot renews the hold (up to an overall cap). You can only hold one slot at a time: holding a new one releases your previous one.

409.description: slot_held (someone else is on it; temporary) or slot_booked (permanent)

422.description: The slot's workstation is not active

delete.summary: Release your hold on a slot
delete.description: Call when the user leaves the confirm screen without booking. Always succeeds, even if there is no hold to release. Skipping it is harmless: the hold lapses on its own after a few minutes.

access_token.description: Send as "Authorization: Bearer <access_token>" on every request

refresh_token.description: Keep this safe; use it only to call /api/refresh

message.example: Another user is selecting this slot right now. It is not available at the moment, but it may become available again shortly.

retry_after.description: Only for slot_held: seconds until the hold lapses at the latest

server_time.description: The server's clock when this was issued. Count down from expires_at - server_time, not from the phone's own clock, which may be wrong.

orders_count.description: Present only when requested with a count

SlotStatus.description: held = another user is on the confirm screen right now (temporary); held_by_you = you are; booked = a non-cancelled order owns it (until cancelled).

is_available.description: True only for status "available" — anyone can take it right now

held_until.description: For held / held_by_you: the latest moment the hold lapses on its own. A held slot may free up sooner.
